sources_fetched.title: Build. Earn. Grow. – Become a Shopify Partner Today - Shopify

record.name: Shopify
record.one_liner: Shopify provides APIs, libraries, and tools including the GraphQL Admin API and Partner API to build apps and integrate with Shopify stores.

auth.notes: Shopify apps authenticate API calls by obtaining an access token via OAuth and sending it in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header.

access.notes: Developers can create new apps, use the Shopify CLI, and generate API clients and tokens directly through the Partner Dashboard.

api_surface.notes: Shopify provides GraphQL Admin and Partner APIs, webhooks, and client libraries for multiple languages.

mcp.notes: Reported value was discarded: no support offered.

buildability.reasoning: Credentials are self-serve (oauth2) and the pages document a usable API surface. (Derived from access, auth and api_surface.)

evidence.claim: Shopify APIs use access tokens sent in headers.
evidence.quote: To call a Shopify API, your code sends an access token in a request header to authenticate the identity that token represents (your app or a buyer) and authorize what that identity can access.

evidence.claim: API clients can be created through the Partner Dashboard.
evidence.quote: You can create a new API client for your organization through the Partner Dashboard.

evidence.claim: Libraries and templates include options for Ruby, Node, PHP, Go, and .NET.
evidence.quote: Libraries and templates include official and community API libraries for Ruby, Node, PHP, Go, and .NET, plus app templates and sample apps.

evidence.claim: Webhooks allow receiving notifications about events in a shop.
evidence.quote: You can use webhook subscriptions to receive notifications about particular events in a shop.
